LEFT JOIN (

FROM [BranchOperationalEvents] AS [b]

    FROM [ProcessedProjectionEvents] AS [p]

FROM [BranchOperationalEvents] AS [b]
WHERE [b].[OccurredAt] > @__lookbackTime_0 AND NOT EXISTS (

    FROM [ProcessedProjectionEvents] AS [p]

    OFFSET @__p_2 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_3 ROWS ONLY
) AS [t0]

    FROM (

        FROM [Visits] AS [v0]
